products.officialProductName: Infrared lamp heating system RTP-mini
products.officialModel: Infrared lamp heating system RTP-mini
products.sourceDescription: This system is a compact desktop type of RTP-6 for conventional infrared-heating system. We have achieved quiet heating with efficient cooling and reduced noise with eliminating the conventional heat exhaust unit and adopting a cooling fan.

products.officialProductName: Thermal Flow Rate Evaluation System for Low Thermal Resistance Multilayer Substrates F-CAL
products.officialModel: Thermal Flow Rate Evaluation System for Low Thermal Resistance Multilayer Substrates F-CAL
products.sourceDescription: It is possible to measure the multilayer materials, which is difficult with the laser flash method. This system is to measure the heat flow rate of a sample. A heating block is contact with the high temperature side of the sample, and the low temperature side of the sample is contacted with a low temperature block which works as both a cooling and a heat flow meter to perform measurement.v It is possible to measure the heat flow rate flowing……
materialCategories: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

verified: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

products.officialProductName: Ultra High Precision Thermal Expansion Measurement System by Laser Interferometer SuperLIX
products.officialModel: Ultra High Precision Thermal Expansion Measurement System by Laser Interferometer SuperLIX
products.sourceDescription: The world of expansion with accuracy of 1×10-8/K or less Thermal expansion measurement with the world-class ultra high accuracy ＊as a commercial measurement system Application case Development of zero-expansion materials Development of negative thermal expansion material and anode materials Development of standard materials Development of materials for actuator

products.officialProductName: Polymeric Thermoelectric Sheet Evaluation System ZEM-d
products.officialModel: Polymeric Thermoelectric Sheet Evaluation System ZEM-d
products.sourceDescription: This system can measure Seebeck coefficient and electrical resistivity in the thickness direction and also evaluate the thermoelectric properties on anisotropic materials at the same measurement direction.

products.officialProductName: Seebeck Coefficient / Electric Resistance Measurement System ZEM-3 series
products.series: Seebeck Coefficient / Electric Resistance Measurement System ZEM-3 series
products.officialModel: Seebeck Coefficient / Electric Resistance Measurement System ZEM-3 series
products.sourceDescription: Simultaneously measures the Seebeck coefficient and electric conductivity of thermoelectric materials. Based on requests from both domestic and international academic societies and customers, this system features our easy to use, high-precision measurement techniques. Complies with JIS standards for thermoelectric material Seebeck coefficient measurement equipment.

products.officialProductName: Atmospheric Thermoelectric Module Evaluation System F-PEM
products.officialModel: Atmospheric Thermoelectric Module Evaluation System F-PEM
products.sourceDescription: The system can evaluate the power generation and heat flow that can be gathered when the temperature difference is given to thermoelectric module in the environment(in atmosphere and under load) and conversion efficiency that can be calculated from maximum power generation and heat flow. In addition, this system can conduct long-hours operation and heat cycle tests of thermoelectric modules and can be used for testing newly developed modules as well as for durability tests under load and temerature in which……

products.officialProductName: Power Generation Efficiency Characteristics Evaluation System PEM-2
products.officialModel: Power Generation Efficiency Characteristics Evaluation System PEM-2
products.sourceDescription: Property evaluations of thermoelectric generator modules By applying a maximum 500°C temperature difference across a thermoelectric generator module, this system finds the thermoelectric conversion rate η by finding the power that is generated P when a one-dimensional heat flow Q is passed through the module.

products.officialProductName: Thermoelectric Conversion Efficiency Evaluation System for Small Modules Mini-PEM
products.officialModel: Thermoelectric Conversion Efficiency Evaluation System for Small Modules Mini-PEM
products.sourceDescription: Measure thermoelectric conversion efficiency for thermoelectric material alone and a pair of thermoelectric material This system can evaluate not only power generation but also conversion efficiency of thermoelectric modules. The conversion efficiency is evaluated from current dependency of power generation measured with four-probe method and heat flow measured with heat flow meter. High temperature part can reach up to 500 ℃(standard specifications), while low temperature part is cooled with water flow.

products.officialProductName: Laser Flash Method Thermal Constant Measurement System TC-1200RH / TC-9000 series
products.series: Laser Flash Method Thermal Constant Measurement System TC-1200RH / TC-9000 series
products.officialModel: Laser Flash Method Thermal Constant Measurement System TC-1200RH / TC-9000 series
products.sourceDescription: Thermal conductivity measurements covering a wide range of materials not only thermoelectric materials but also metals, ceramics, carbon etc. The systems measure 3 thermal constants (Thermal diffusivity, Specific heat capacity, Thermal conductivity) for uniform solid materials such as thermoelectric materials, ceramics, carbon, Metal, etc

products.officialProductName: Scanning Thermal Probe Micro-image STPM-1000
products.officialModel: Scanning Thermal Probe Micro-image STPM-1000
products.sourceDescription: 2 dimensional distribution of Seebeck coefficient and thermal conductivity measurement system by thermal probe STPM-1000 is used for evaluating Seebeck coefficient and thermal conductivity simultaneously. Simple evaluation of thermoelectric materials is possible by simultaneous evaluations of seebeck coefficient and thermal conductivity. The thermal conductivity distribution evaluation of functionally graded materials, multilayer substrates and organic materials is also possible. STPM-1000 is expected to use materials evaluation as a basic tool.

products.officialProductName: Thermal Diffusivity measurement system by Xe flash method TD-1
products.officialModel: Thermal Diffusivity measurement system by Xe flash method TD-1
products.sourceDescription: Capable of evaluation of heat radiation film in the thickness direction and anisotropy The most suitable system for the evaluations of heat dissipation films etc. By using Xenon lamp, it enables to minimize the damage to the sample. Sample anisotropy can also easily measure by using the original attachment as an option.
materialCategories: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

verified: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

products.officialProductName: 2-Omega Method Nano Thin Film Thermal Conductivity Meter TCN-2ω
products.officialModel: 2-Omega Method Nano Thin Film Thermal Conductivity Meter TCN-2ω
products.sourceDescription: Thermal conductivity evaluation for a nano thin film at normal direction TCN-2ω is the world’s only system which can measure thermal conductivity for a nano thin film at normal direction.

products.officialProductName: AC Method Thermal Diffusivity Measurement System LaserPIT
products.officialModel: AC Method Thermal Diffusivity Measurement System LaserPIT
products.sourceDescription: Thermal conductivity evaluation in-plane direction of films, thin sheets and thin films etc. This system can measure thermal diffusivity of sheet materials in-plane direction by scanning laser heating AC method (Angstrom method). About high thermal conducting films, sub-micron thin films can also be measurable.
materialCategories: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

verified: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

products.officialProductName: Periodical Heating Method Thermal Diffusivity Measurement System FTC series
products.series: Periodical Heating Method Thermal Diffusivity Measurement System FTC series
products.officialModel: Periodical Heating Method Thermal Diffusivity Measurement System FTC series
products.sourceDescription: Easily evaluate thin film materials that are difficult to measure with the flash method This system measures thermal diffusivity in the thickness direction of solids such as film polymers, paper, and ceramics by using the AC joule heating method. With specialized in room temperature measurement only, which is highly needed, a compact body and low cost have been achieved.
materialCategories: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

verified: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

products.officialProductName: Steady Method Thermal Conductivity Measurement System GH series
products.series: Steady Method Thermal Conductivity Measurement System GH series
products.officialModel: Steady Method Thermal Conductivity Measurement System GH series
products.sourceDescription: Thermal conductivity evaluations of polymers and glass A heat-flow method Steady Method Thermal Conductivity Measurement System that complies with the US ASTM E1530 standard. This system measures comparatively low-thermal conductivity materials over a temperature range of 50 to 280°C.
materialCategories: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

verified: Polymer materials and thermosetting resins, Various films and sheets

products.officialProductName: Rapid Multi Property Measurement System RMP-1
products.officialModel: Rapid Multi Property Measurement System RMP-1
products.sourceDescription: Heating up to 3000K within one second! This system measures thermophysical properties by applying current directly to a sample to heat up to higher temperature within one second. Measurable standard properties are electrical resistivity, total emissivity, specific heat capacity, thermal expansion rate and thermal diffusivity.

products.officialProductName: Electric Heat Resistance Measurment System EHR series
products.series: Electric Heat Resistance Measurment System EHR series
products.officialModel: Electric Heat Resistance Measurment System EHR series
products.sourceDescription: Temperature dependency measurement of insulator samples This system can measure the temperature dependency of insulators like ceramics, plastics and glass.

products.officialProductName: Electric Resistance Measurement System for Metals and Semiconductors TER series
products.series: Electric Resistance Measurement System for Metals and Semiconductors TER series
products.officialModel: Electric Resistance Measurement System for Metals and Semiconductors TER series
products.sourceDescription: Metallic phase transition, aging, recrystallization reaction This system can measure precisely the electric resistance of metallic alloys and semiconductors with DC four-thermal method.

products.officialProductName: Adiabatic Specific Heat Measurement System SH-3000 series
products.series: Adiabatic Specific Heat Measurement System SH-3000 series
products.officialModel: Adiabatic Specific Heat Measurement System SH-3000 series
products.sourceDescription: Measures specific heat capacity, latent heat, transformation points Capable of precisely measuring specific heat capacity, latent heat, and transformation points with the adiabatic control method.

products.officialProductName: Thermodilatometer DL-9000 / DLY-9000 series
products.series: Thermodilatometer DL-9000 / DLY-9000 series
products.officialModel: Thermodilatometer DL-9000 / DLY-9000 series
products.sourceDescription: Dedicated thermal expansion measurement system for bulk materials Dedicated linear expansion and contraction measurement system for various solid samples

products.officialProductName: Robotic Thermal Dilatometer DLY-9000 ROBOT
products.officialModel: Robotic Thermal Dilatometer DLY-9000 ROBOT
products.sourceDescription: Labour-saving quality management with fully automatic and unattended operationuality control. This system was developed for the purpose of standardizing the measurement and saving labor in quality management. With superior repeatability, safety measures for unattended operation and chart function, this system is most suitable for quality management.

products.officialProductName: Thermal Expansion  Measurment Systemby Laser Interferometer LIX-2 series
products.series: Thermal Expansion  Measurment Systemby Laser Interferometer LIX-2 series
products.officialModel: Thermal Expansion  Measurment Systemby Laser Interferometer LIX-2 series
products.sourceDescription: High-accuracy measurement of thermal expansion with a minimum resolution of 1nm This is a laser thermal expansion measurement system with ultra-high sensitivity developed by the use of the latest optical techniques. This system is suitable to be used as a calibration system for a standard thermal dilatometer, also to measure absolute thermal expansion measurements of unknown samples. This system is compliant with JIS R3251-1995, Measuring method of the linear thermal expansion coefficient for low expansion glass by laser interferometry.

products.officialProductName: Thermoｍechanical Analyzer TM-9000 series
products.series: Thermoｍechanical Analyzer TM-9000 series
products.officialModel: Thermoｍechanical Analyzer TM-9000 series
products.sourceDescription: Capable of viscoelasticity measurements in various atmospheres Measures the thermal expansion and contraction of solid samples. Capable of stress relaxation measurements. Capable of performing thermal expansion measurements by tension to film materials

products.officialProductName: Thermogravimetry / Differential Thermal Analyzer TGD-9000 series
products.series: Thermogravimetry / Differential Thermal Analyzer TGD-9000 series
products.officialModel: Thermogravimetry / Differential Thermal Analyzer TGD-9000 series
products.sourceDescription: Unique single TG and separate DTA measurements The TGD-9000 series is capable of performing TG/DTA measurements in a wide range of temperatures from room temperature to ultra-high temperature regions. Models equipped with the Infrared Gold Image Furnace can perform measurements with various heating conditions.

products.officialProductName: Differential Scanning Calorimeter DSC-R series
products.series: Differential Scanning Calorimeter DSC-R series
products.officialModel: Differential Scanning Calorimeter DSC-R series
products.sourceDescription: A high-sensitivity sensor is standard equipment on all models Achieves a high-stability baseline through its precise thermal design

products.officialProductName: Vapor Pressure Evaluation System VPE-9000<vacuum thermobalance>
products.officialModel: Vapor Pressure Evaluation System VPE-9000<vacuum thermobalance>
products.sourceDescription: Stable changes in weight in a high vacuum This system evaluates saturated vapor pressure and the thermal behavior of organic materials. An exhaust method is employed that allows stable measurements even in a vacuum. Achieves precise temperature controllability and responsiveness with the Infrared Gold Image Furnace

products.officialProductName: Organic Pigment Material Sublimating / Refining System TRS series
products.series: Organic Pigment Material Sublimating / Refining System TRS series
products.officialModel: Organic Pigment Material Sublimating / Refining System TRS series
products.sourceDescription: Easy purification of Organic materials General organic pigment is poor in purity, containing lots of impurity. Therefore the property of the thin film roduced in a condition poor in purity does not show its original features, varying with the impurity. This system can produce highly pure organic materials.

products.officialProductName: Infrared Gold Image Furnace RHL-E/VHT/P series
products.series: Infrared Gold Image Furnace RHL-E/VHT/P series
products.officialModel: Infrared Gold Image Furnace RHL-E/VHT/P series
products.sourceDescription: Meeting customer needs with infrared lamp heating Infrared Gold Image Furnaces can be used in many fields for research and development or as production equipment. We’re meeting the needs of our customers from high speed heating to wide area heating.

products.officialProductName: Infrared Gold Image Furnace Ps, Pss series
products.series: Infrared Gold Image Furnace Ps, Pss series
products.officialModel: Infrared Gold Image Furnace Ps, Pss series
products.sourceDescription: Useable in wide fields from carbon nanotube growth equipment to production equipment. The flat plate reflected infrared heating furnace can be used for applications such as a 2-inch to 300 mm diameter wafer lamp annealing system or a production baking furnace.

products.officialProductName: Programmable Temperature Controller TPC-5000 series
products.series: Programmable Temperature Controller TPC-5000 series
products.officialModel: Programmable Temperature Controller TPC-5000 series
products.sourceDescription: Temperature controller capable of supporting high-speed heating with good precision. This programmable temperature controller can support not only Infrared Gold Image Furnaces that require a fast response during high-speed heating , but also low-speed heating furnaces. It features high functionality and high performance in a compact package and meets your needs with a low price and many accessories.

products.officialProductName: Rapid Thermal Annealing System RTA series
products.series: Rapid Thermal Annealing System RTA series
products.officialModel: Rapid Thermal Annealing System RTA series
products.sourceDescription: High speed heat treatment from 2 inches to 300 mm 10 seconds until retention. Infrared lamp heating is the method which can take advantage of its features of High energy density, Near infrared rays, High heat responsiveness, Temperature controllability, and Cold wall method. We’re meeting the needs of our customers with supplying RTA Series, which can control the process recipe (heating and cooling) and gas type with its flow amount. The system is suitable for finding the best heating conditions.

products.officialProductName: Low Cost Infrared Lamp Heating System for R&D RTP-6
products.officialModel: Low Cost Infrared Lamp Heating System for R&D RTP-6
products.sourceDescription: 80°C/s high speed annealing possible at low cost. This infrared lamp heating system with parabolic type reflectors can heat uniformly a wafer of the size up to 6 inches. It is capable of high-speed heat treatment, the most available for the research and development of heat treatment process. Silicide formation in individual semiconductor process and process annealing of compound semiconductor are available.

products.officialProductName: Mini Lamp Annealer  MILA-5050
products.officialModel: Mini Lamp Annealer  MILA-5050
products.sourceDescription: This system is a Mini Lamp Annealer that enables the heat treatment up to 50mm square size samples. MILA-5000 series, the current models which are available for up to 20mm square size samples, have been velued by many customers since their release. But in response to increased number of demands from customers that they want to heat bigger samples, this new system, available for heat treatment of up to 50mm square size samples has been developed with still having a……

products.officialProductName: Mini Lamp Annealer MILA-5000 series
products.series: Mini Lamp Annealer MILA-5000 series
products.officialModel: Mini Lamp Annealer MILA-5000 series
products.sourceDescription: MILA-5000 series The MILA-5000 series can perform high speed heating, high speed cooling, and clean heating, which are characteristics of the Infrared Gold Image Furnace. It can heat materials under adjustable atmospheres and combines a temperature controller and variable atmosphere chamber into a single low-cost infrared lamp heating system. Heating operations can be run by a PC connected via USB and data can be easily managed. MILA-5000UHV Based on the MILA-5000-P-N (high temperature type), the MILA-5000UHV was born as a……

products.officialProductName: Mini Lamp Annealer with air-cooling system MILA-700AR
products.officialModel: Mini Lamp Annealer with air-cooling system MILA-700AR
products.sourceDescription: ini Lamp Annealer with no use of cooling water As the cooling method is air-cooling with a fan, the heating operations can be easily started with just a wall outlet.

products.officialProductName: Simplified Infrared Lamp Heating System SSA series
products.series: Simplified Infrared Lamp Heating System SSA series
products.officialModel: Simplified Infrared Lamp Heating System SSA series
products.sourceDescription: Simplified system with Infrared Gold Image Furnace and a quartz chamber. A low-cost heating system consist of an Infrared Golc Image Furnace and quartz chamber including a sample holder.

products.officialProductName: Infrared Lamp Heating System QHC series/Variable Atmosphere Lamp Heating System VHC series
products.series: Infrared Lamp Heating System QHC series/Variable Atmosphere Lamp Heating System VHC series
products.officialModel: Infrared Lamp Heating System QHC series/Variable Atmosphere Lamp Heating System VHC series
products.sourceDescription: Helping process development From solar cells to compound semiconductors. Combining an Infrared Gold Image Furnace and temperature controller, the QHC/VHC series is a compact high speed heating/ cooling system equipped with a quartz heat treatment chamber. The system is customizable to your needs.

products.officialProductName: Spot Focused Infrared Gold Image Furnace System series
products.series: Spot Focused Infrared Gold Image Furnace System series
products.officialModel: Spot Focused Infrared Gold Image Furnace System series
products.sourceDescription: Heating up to 1800°C in just 1 min. For ultra-high temperature vacuum heat treatment MIRO series is a compact spot focused Gold Image Furnace which enables to heat up to 1800°C with extremely high reflection efficiency in combination with single or double type chambers.

products.officialProductName: Rapid Heating / Water Quenching System CAS-59AQ
products.series: Rapid Heating / Water Quenching System CAS-59AQ
products.officialModel: Rapid Heating / Water Quenching System CAS-59AQ
products.sourceDescription: Rapid heating and quenching of materials This system is capable of water quench after heating. The maximum temperature is 1800°C under various atmospheres.

products.officialProductName: High Temperature Rapid Thermal Annealing System  HT-RTA59HD
products.officialModel: High Temperature Rapid Thermal Annealing System  HT-RTA59HD
products.sourceDescription: Heating a small piece of sample up to 1800°C just in 10 seconds. HT-RTA59HD is a desktop-type lamp annealing system which enables a small piece of sample to heat up to 1800°C (Ultrahigh temperature zone) just in 10 seconds with high reflection efficiency by spot focused heating.

products.officialProductName: Production Heat Treatment Furnace (Manufacturing Line Equipment)
products.officialModel: Production Heat Treatment Furnace (Manufacturing Line Equipment)
products.sourceDescription: Heationg system according to heat treatment objective This heating system is desiged based on the shape of the material and the heat treatment objective in the process. By making maximum use of high-speed heating, cooling and clean heating, we provide heating furnaces with non-polluting, low energy and high functionality.

products.officialProductName: Continuous Annealing System for Steel Sheet CAS series
products.series: Continuous Annealing System for Steel Sheet CAS series
products.officialModel: Continuous Annealing System for Steel Sheet CAS series
products.sourceDescription: Easy determination of transformation point of steel sheets The CAS series achieves high-speed heating and cooling with the use of an Infrared Gold Image Furnace, direct temperature control of the samples, and easy atmosphere production. This system makes it possible to precisely achieve thermal treatment simulations of processes for steel and iron materials that had been previously difficult. Supports general purpose heat treatment tests to process heat treatment simulation tests of materials such as steel sheets, steel plates, stainless steel……

products.officialProductName: High Temperature Observation System TMS series
products.series: High Temperature Observation System TMS series
products.officialModel: High Temperature Observation System TMS series
products.sourceDescription: Vivid observations with image heating and the latest optical system Capable of observations of the crystal transformation, deposition, and solidification of metallic materials, capable of observations of the molten state and deposits of various materials, and capable of thermal cycle measurements of polymer materials from crystals → molten → re-solidification

products.officialProductName: Micro-Indentation Tester μIT-1
products.officialModel: Micro-Indentation Tester μIT-1
products.sourceDescription: With pressing a conical indenter against a small sample, creep behavior can be measured under high temperature. With the Micro-Indentation Tester based on new principles, this system does not require large samples like past systems.

products.officialProductName: Arc Plasma Source APS-1
products.officialModel: Arc Plasma Source APS-1
products.sourceDescription: Simultaneous deposition of different “targets” By adding this source to APD series or your vacuum chamber, different “targets” can be deposited simultaneously and materials with new characters can be produced.

products.officialProductName: Arc-Plasma method nano-particle Deposition System APD series
products.series: Arc-Plasma method nano-particle Deposition System APD series
products.officialModel: Arc-Plasma method nano-particle Deposition System APD series
products.sourceDescription: New nanoparticle deposition system using pulse vacuum arc discharge Pulse vacuum arc deposition is a unique technique to deposit ultrathin films and nanoparticles by generating metal ions in a simple process. This system can achieve high in terms of film flatness and particle fineness, which is impossible with other systems.

products.officialProductName: Hight Temperature Wettability Evaluation System by Contact Angle at the Solid-Liquid Interface WET-1200
products.officialModel: Hight Temperature Wettability Evaluation System by Contact Angle at the Solid-Liquid Interface WET-1200
products.sourceDescription: Capable of precise observations of substrate and ingot wettability This system has been commercialized as a compact, low-cost high-temperature wettability test/contact angle measurement system based on the wettability test/contact angle measurement system delivered to the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency in 1993. This system can perform measurements by the static drop method. The extruded liquid drop method is also available(optional).

products.officialProductName: Temperature-Programmed Desorption Gas Analyzer TDS-M202R
products.officialModel: Temperature-Programmed Desorption Gas Analyzer TDS-M202R
products.sourceDescription: Reach a target temperature for a short time, Mass analysis of up to 200amu is available This system can measure the gas desorbed from a sample with a quadro-pole mass filter after heating up to a target temperature.

products.officialProductName: Microbial Activity Measurement System Antares/Spica/Leonis
products.officialModel: Microbial Activity Measurement System Antares/Spica/Leonis
products.sourceDescription: Capable of monitoring microbial growth activity in real time This system measures “heat” generated from microbial cells in real time and evaluates the microbial growth activity. Even if a sample is non-uniform including solid or liquid, the system can measure in a non-destructive manner without changing the sample’s original shape.

products.officialProductName: Handy Spot welder HS-9000
products.officialModel: Handy Spot welder HS-9000
products.sourceDescription: Universal handy welder It is suitable for spot-welding of metals like thermocouples, foil and thin plate. By local-quick welding, precise welding with less oxidation and heat deformation can be available.

products.officialProductName: Handy Arc welder HA-1H
products.officialModel: Handy Arc welder HA-1H
products.sourceDescription: Compact handy welder with safety handling With high-temperature carbon arc, it melts wires completely to create a spherical junction. By the use of special flux, anti-oxidation layers can be created, making a good contact point easily.
